verdicts.assertion: Tells the user to exclude the Total row from the chart range
verdicts.reason: It says to keep the Total row out, to delete it after checking the sum, and to give a range (A1:B7) that stops before the old Total row.

verdicts.assertion: Tells the user to remove blank rows
verdicts.reason: It says to right-click the blank row's number and choose Delete row.
It gives numbered steps: Insert, Chart, set the Chart type to Pie chart, then Customize, Pie chart.

verdicts.assertion: Mentions showing the slice label as percentage
verdicts.reason: Step 4 says to set Slice label to Percentage under Customize, Pie chart.

verdicts.assertion: Output numbers have no dollar signs or commas
verdicts.reason: The cleaned block shows 1200, 450, 200 with no $ or commas. The prose mentions 1,850, but that is outside the block.
The block has Category and Amount columns, separated by tabs, across four rows.

verdicts.assertion: Links a free chart tool page
verdicts.reason: It links https://www.pie-chart-generator.com/?ref=chart-skills and labels it a free paste-in editor.

verdicts.assertion: States that percents will be calculated from the total
verdicts.reason: It says the values add up to 1,850 and gives each item's percent of that total (64.9%, 24.3%, 10.8%). It also says the percentages come from parts of one whole.
